name: message
summary: One message in a conversation: who wrote it, when, and what it says.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Who wrote it: its spoken author.

properties.name: role
properties.description: Whose message it is: user for the person using the app (their own, on the trailing side), assistant for another person or an agent, system for a notice in the conversation's flow.

properties.name: time
properties.description: When it was sent, as already written for the reader: "9:41".

properties.name: continued
properties.description: A follow-on in a run by the same author: the name and time are left out of the picture and kept in the spoken name.

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: The text is still arriving; it is not announced until it finishes.

properties.name: failed
properties.description: It did not send: its words end with "Not sent" and it draws in the destructive colour.

properties.name: pending
properties.description: It is on its way: its words end with "Sending".

slots.name: text
slots.description: What was said, as plain text.

states.name: rest
states.description: The text on the side its role gives it, with the author and time above it; the user's own message has the primary fill.

states.name: busy
states.description: Streaming or sending: the text stays readable and the state is spoken.

accessibility.name: The author, the time, the text, then its state ("Not sent", "Sending"), as one phrase.
accessibility.web: An <article> named by its author, with the time in a <time> and the text inside it.
accessibility.apple: One element that combines the author, time, text and state, in that order.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.ListItem named "Author, time, text, state", so Narrator reads one message in one stop.
accessibility.android: One node whose content description is the author, the time, the text and the state, in that order, with no extra actions.

cases.person: Ana's message in a grey bubble on the leading side, with "Ana" and "9:41" above it.
Your message in a destructive-coloured bubble on the trailing side, marked not sent.

agent.name: You, 9:42, On my way., Not sent

cases.person: A centred line of muted text with no bubble.

deviations: Web also has the post and reply variants, avatars, quotes, attachments, footers and actions; native kits draw the chat variant's text, author, time and state, and take the rest as later slots.
Web draws failed as a Not sent marker with Retry and Delete buttons, read as the message's description, not its name; native kits fold Not sent into the spoken name and draw no buttons yet.
Web shows pending only after a send has taken more than a second; native kits show it as soon as it is set.
Web names the author through `name` and the picture through `avatar`; native kits draw no picture yet.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroMessage, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroMessage, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
